description: Read-only contract call (eth_call) on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: returned bytes or the revert reason, at a named block. Nothing is signed or sent. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

data.description: hex calldata: 4-byte selector plus ABI-encoded arguments

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: evm_call
